items.headline: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.excerpt: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

items.headline: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items.excerpt: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

items.headline: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
items.excerpt: Discover how ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers accelerate CAD, PCB design, simulation, and other workflows across the physical world.

items.headline: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
items.excerpt: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.

items.headline: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
items.excerpt: Discover how Heimstaden uses OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to transform property management, cut costs, and empower employees across Europe.

items.headline: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
items.excerpt: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.

items.headline: Scaling Git at OpenAI
items.excerpt: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.

items.headline: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

items.headline: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
items.excerpt: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

items.headline: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
items.excerpt: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

items.headline: LifeVal
items.excerpt: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

items.headline: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
items.excerpt: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll to advise on responsible AI for national security modernization, cyber resilience, and collaboration with U.S. allies.

items.headline: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
items.excerpt: Qodo brings company knowledge and coding standards into Codex, helping developers catch P0 issues across repositories before opening a pull request.

items.headline: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
items.excerpt: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

items.headline: Community safety report and new protections for teens
items.excerpt: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

items.headline: Fair use benefits everyone
items.excerpt: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.

items.headline: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

items.headline: How we detect frontier model misalignment
items.excerpt: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

items.headline: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
items.excerpt: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

items.headline: Credit Saison achieves 954% ROI in a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot
items.excerpt: Credit Saison’s ChatGPT Enterprise pilot delivered 954% ROI. See how leaders and employees helped turn the results into companywide adoption.
